PPSSPP passes dlext 0x200 and 0x210 (namespace plus library-FD; FORCE_LOAD is 0x40), which ordinary dlopen cannot honor. The partial two-export shim rejects nonzero flags without a real backend; preserve caller LR on ordinary tail dispatch and check ABI JSON fields rather than exit status alone. Keep the gated ELF unstripped: lost hidden function labels can pollute abi_diff call attribution. See benchmark/2026-10-01-u10-native-shims/.

R8 ROUTE_A_INPUTS is not the current host main: N4 frozen source7fe4369d plus N11 baseline receipt reproduces current1d3b0881; require baseline calls0 first. NOLOAD same-address views avoid fresh abort owners and inherited-view two-hop ambiguity. Exact OH OpenSLES05d8ac90 uses IID24 and GetState eight-byte store0x13a88 versus Android16/4; direct vtable casts are unsafe even though engine creation ignores arrays. Keep audio forwarding held, not a failure stub. See benchmark/2026-10-01-u10-native-shims/.
